purpose: Measure directly how much information the dropped electrodes add and how much they cost as inputs, with surrogates that keep the part of each dropped electrode the kept ones predict and replace the rest by another trial's residual.
claim_boundary: Exploratory for BCI IV 2a, planned after its test results and after the input-kind study. For Lee2019 the predictions are fixed before any of these models is scored on Lee2019 session 2, but the input-kind results (including its interpolated cost and information) and the references' test results were known; four predictions, no correction for multiplicity. It explains a result; it does not change the frozen 2a configuration.

S1.claim: The dropped electrodes' unpredictable part carries information
S1.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: real-46 minus surr-46 (mean of draws d0, d1)

S2.claim: A residual unrelated to the trial still costs accuracy
S2.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: surr-46 (mean of d0, d1) minus relevance-16 (scripts/electrode_data_study.py)

S3.claim: An input the kept electrodes predict completely has no visible cost
S3.contrast: Lee2019 final models, next day: pred-46 minus relevance-16
S3.test: interval lower bound above -2 points (as K1 of scripts/input_kind_study.py)

S4.claim: The less of the dropped electrodes the kept ones predict, the larger a person's cost
S4.contrast: Spearman correlation over the 54 people between the unexplained share of the dropped electrodes (scripts/input_kind_study.py predictability: session 1, mean over its folds and the dropped electrodes) and the person's cost, surr-46 (mean of d0, d1) minus relevance-16, final models, next day
S4.test: participant-bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples, seed 690) upper bound below 0

readings.S1 and S2 hold: information and cost both exist and cancel: report the measured numbers
readings.S2 does not hold: the dropped electrodes neither cost nor add much: 16 suffice because the others are redundant; rewrite the course report's Section 6.2 and slides 12-13 accordingly
readings.S2 holds, S1 does not: a cost without information would make 16 clearly better than all electrodes, which contradicts the earlier results; find out why before writing anything

references.full: full-22 / full-62 of scripts/overfit_study.py: the same electrodes as real in another input order; on Lee2019 also the held-out-runs stand-in for real, which is not trained on the folds here

kinds.real: the dropped electrodes (prediction + the trial's own residual)
kinds.pred: the least-squares prediction from the kept electrodes alone
kinds.surr: the prediction + another trial's residual, all dropped electrodes of a trial moved together

fit: per participant and split: least squares with intercept from the kept electrodes to each dropped electrode, every time sample of every training trial one observation (final: all of session 1; folds: their training runs); the same fit as mibci.input_kind.unexplained_fraction
derangements: uniform by rejection, seeded by SHA-256 of (dataset, participant, split, set of trials, draw): the training trials, the held-out runs, session 2 (2a: artifact-free trials and the others separately)
analysis: seeds (and draws, and folds) averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690); BCI IV 2a on artifact-free session-2 trials, Lee2019 on all; 2a also with the seed error
